notes.message: VM names must be unique across the project unless its vmDnsSetting is ZonalOnly, so this rule is placed at project scope although the API path is zones/{zone}/instances

The provider limits project-id:instance-id to 98 characters; the instance ID alone is capped at 67 (98 minus the longest project ID, 30, minus 1). The alphanumeric-end requirement is a conservative limit with no documented source (D20)
Dotted names may be up to 222 characters, but the engine never generates dots and keeps 63 (conservative, D20)
